instruction: Look at task-014_initial.scad. Build a U-shaped fork bracket with envelope 80 x 56 x 52 mm. Include an 80 x 56 x 8 mm base, two side cheeks, a 12 mm cross pin hole running along the X axis through both cheeks at y=0,z=34, four 6 mm base mounting holes at (+/-25,+/-15), and two triangular gusset ribs rising from the base to the cheeks. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-014_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
